module: Nitrous oxide (NOS) injection submodule for a combustion engine. It is NOT an independent powertrain component: it does not export `new`; it is a module with global state in the file (a single instance per vehicle VM), initialized by the engine with `init(device, data)`. It reads three electrics values (arming, override, activation), adds torque to the engine (`engine.nitrousOxideTorque`) according to a per-RPM table, consumes energy from the registered `n2o` tanks and handles the purging of the lines (particles and sound).
usage:
electrics.values.nitrousOxideArm = 1       -- arm (>= 1)
electrics.values.nitrousOxideOverride = 1  -- force the injection without conditions
print(electrics.values.nitrousOxideActive)
notes: Jbeam keys read in data (init): addedPower (kW), cutInRPM (cut-in speed, default = engine idleRPM, clamped to 0.9 * maxRPM), cutInRange (RPM of progressive ramp-up, 50), electricsArmName ('nitrousOxideArm'), electricsOverrideName ('nitrousOxideOverride'), electricsActiveName ('nitrousOxideActive'), minimumGear (0), volumeCoef (1.5, multiplies the engine sound volume when the NOS is active), purgeValves_nodes (list of node cid pairs). initSounds reads data.purgeSoundEvent ('event:>Vehicle>Nitrous_Purging') and purgeSoundVolume (1). If data is nil, the module is disabled (updateGFX = nop).

Activation conditions (per frame): (armed AND engine throttle >= 1 AND RPM >= cutInRPM AND |electrics.gearIndex| >= minimumGear AND clutch not used (electrics.clutch == 0)) OR manual override, AND liquid available, AND no purge in progress. Arming and override are read from electrics.values with a threshold >= 1.

Effects on the engine: engine.nitrousOxideTorque += additional torque (N·m, = added power / angular speed), engine.engineVolumeCoef *= volumeCoef if torque > 0, engine.invBurnEfficiencyCoef *= 2 when active. The engine must reset these fields to their value before each call to updateGFX. The consumption goes through engine.spentEnergyNitrousOxide shared between the registered tanks.
Public fields: isExisting (true), isArmed (boolean updated every frame), isActive (boolean), updateGFX and updateSounds (reassigned by init; nop by default).

Bugs / pitfalls: the nitrousOxideTorqueLookup torque tables are filled at index i + 1 (value for i RPM) but are read at the integer RPM index (updateGFX) or rpm (getAddedTorque): a one-RPM offset with no practical consequence. registerStorage crashes if the storage name is unknown (storage nil, then storage.storedEnergy). updateGFX reads abs(electrics.values.gearIndex): error if gearIndex does not exist. cutInRange = 0 gives a division by zero. Only one engine at a time (global state in the module).

isExisting.desc: Always true: allows testing whether the NOS module is present on the vehicle.

isArmed.desc: true if the NOS is armed (electrics nitrousOxideArm >= 1).

isActive.desc: true if the injection is in progress (conditions met, liquid present, no purge).

updateGFX.desc: Per-frame update function: nop until init, then the real function. Called by the engine after preparing nitrousOxideTorque.

updateSounds.desc: Sound function: nop (the real function is empty).

init.desc: Initializes the module for an engine: builds the additional torque tables per RPM (progressive ramp-up from cutInStart to cutInRPM), reads the electrics names, the minimum gear, the purge valves. Called by the combustion engine at initialization; with data nil, disables the module.

device.desc: Combustion engine (idleRPM, maxRPM, outputAV1, throttle, nitrousOxideTorque, engineVolumeCoef, invBurnEfficiencyCoef…).

data.desc: NOS jbeam data (addedPower in kW, cutInRPM, electricsArmName…); nil to disable.

initSounds.desc: Reads the purge sound event and volume from the jbeam. Called at engine sound initialization.

resetSounds.desc: Stops the purge sounds of all valves. Called at sound reset.

reset.desc: Resets the states (arming, override, purge, registered tanks, energy). Called at vehicle reset.

getAddedTorque.desc: Returns the table of additional torque (N·m) per RPM of the engine torque curve (indexed like torqueCurve, k+1), without any activation condition. Used to draw the torque curve with NOS.

registerStorage.desc: Registers an energy tank (nitrous liquid) of the engine for NOS consumption. Called by the engine for each energy storage of the expected type.

getTankRatio.desc: Returns the average of the relative level (remainingRatio, 0..1) of the registered tanks, or 0 if there are none. Useful for a gauge.

purgeLines.desc: Starts the purging of the NOS lines for purgeTime seconds (particles and sound at the valves) if there are purge valves and liquid; otherwise resets the purge time to 0. Blocks the injection during the purge.

getPurgeTimeRemaining.desc: Returns the remaining purge time in seconds (0 if no purge).
